title: Five figures Mistral published with the Large 4 weights
intro: Move across the prices and the scores on Mistral’s 29 October weights post. Each stop is a different measure. The page does not combine them.
note: These are Mistral’s figures. The prices are what its API charges per million tokens. FrontierCode 2.0 is Cognition’s private benchmark, as Mistral reports it. The 96.6% refusal is the average Mistral states for the cyber prompts of JailbreakBench, StrongREJECT and AgentHarm. Finch and BrowseComp are Mistral’s readings; it says the 75% was an earlier checkpoint. Left off this slider, because a Hugging Face post the same day gives different numbers: Terminal-Bench 4 (Mistral 41%, Hugging Face 28.3%), the Coding Agent Index (48% and 49.8%), and Lakera’s B3 (Mistral 97.1% against a 93.3% preview; Hugging Face states 93.3%). The posts do not say the settings match. This is not an independent rerun.
